speaker: Doctor
text: Given the MRI findings and your symptoms, you are experiencing acute lumbar radiculopathy secondary to an L5-S1 disc herniation. I recommend starting with conservative management including rest, NSAIDs for pain control, and avoiding heavy lifting or twisting motions. If symptoms persist or worsen, please follow up for physical therapy referral.
